description_en: Retrieves the details of a resource group
kebab_example: aliyun eas describe-resource --cluster-id cn-shanghai --resource-id eas-r-asdasdasd --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeResource

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cluster where the resource group resides
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. To query the resource group ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412133.html
parameters.help_zh: 资源组的ID。如何查询资源组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412133.html
parameters.name: resource_id

ClusterId.description_en: The ID of the cluster where the resource group resides

CpuCount.description_en: The total number of CPU cores

CpuUsed.description_en: The number of CPU cores in use

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the resource group was created, in UTC and RFC 3339 format
CreateTime.description_zh: 资源组创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 时间

ExtraData.description_en: The additional information, such as the VPC connectivity status and Simple Log Service status
ExtraData.description_zh: 额外信息。如VPC打通状态，SLS日志状态等

Features.description_en: The set of features supported by the resource group
Features.description_zh: 资源组的功能集合，用于标识该资源组支持的特性

items.description_en: A specific feature supported by the resource group. Currently, only GpuShare (GPU splitting) is supported
items.description_zh: 资源组所支持的具体特性。目前只支持GpuShare(GPU共享)

GpuUsed.description_en: The number of GPUs in use

InstanceCount.description_en: The total number of machine instances in the resource group
InstanceCount.description_zh: 资源组中机器实例总数

InstanceMaxAllocatableCPU.description_en: The maximum number of allocatable CPU cores per node in the resource group
InstanceMaxAllocatableCPU.description_zh: 资源组单节点最大可分配CPU核数

InstanceMaxAllocatableGPU.description_en: The maximum number of allocatable GPUs per node in the resource group
InstanceMaxAllocatableGPU.description_zh: 资源组单节点最大可分配GPU数

InstanceMaxAllocatableMemory.description_en: The maximum allocatable memory size per node in the resource group
InstanceMaxAllocatableMemory.description_zh: 资源组单节点最大可分配Memory大小

MemoryUsed.description_en: The amount of memory in use, in MB

OwnerUid.description_en: The ID of the resource group owner

PostPaidInstanceCount.description_en: The total number of pay-as-you-go machine instances in the resource group
PostPaidInstanceCount.description_zh: 资源组中后付费机器实例总数

PrePaidInstanceCount.description_en: The total number of subscription machine instances in the resource group
PrePaidInstanceCount.description_zh: 资源组中预付费机器实例总数

ResourceId.description_en: The Elastic Algorithm Service resource ID

ResourceName.description_en: The Elastic Algorithm Service resource name

ResourceType.description_en:
The resource group type. Valid values:

Dedicated: dedicated resource group
SelfManaged: self-managed resource group
ResourceType.description_zh:
资源组类型，取值如下：

Dedicated：专属资源组
SelfManaged：自运维资源组

ServiceCount.description_en: The number of services deployed in the resource group
ServiceCount.description_zh: 资源组部署的服务数量

Status.description_en: The status of the resource group

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the resource group was last updated, in UTC and RFC 3339 format
UpdateTime.description_zh: 资源组最后更新时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 时间

UsageMode.description_en: The usage mode of the resource group
